# survey.oze.au

> Reusable survey platform for the oze.au family. Live host: https://survey.oze.net.au

## Monthly voting poll

- URL: https://survey.oze.net.au/s/monthly-poll
- Open each month from August 2026 through Victorian election day 28 November 2026
- One combined survey: Victorian state voting intention + next federal election
- Federal answer is treated as the same for both houses
- One response per person per month
- Not a scientific poll and not a forecast
- Sourced pollster averages and candidate ledger: https://electiontracker.au/

## Other surveys

- Money in Your Wallet: https://survey.oze.net.au/s/money — Australian currency knowledge.
